description: Prompt Builder presets for curated SD LoRAs (icons, FX, and detailing).

presets.label: Fantasy Icon Base
presets.prompt: isometric fantasy item icon, centered subject, dramatic rim light, ornate detailing, painterly edges, highly readable silhouette
presets.negative: low quality, blurry, text, watermark, cropped

presets.label: Handpainted RPG Icons
presets.prompt: hand painted rpg game icon, fantasy ui element, textured brush strokes, rich color palette, crisp edges, dramatic lighting

presets.label: Gilded Ornament Detail
presets.prompt: baroque gold carving trim, intricate filigree, reflective metal highlights, studio lighting, high detail
presets.negative: flat shading, dull, plastic, low contrast

presets.label: Particle FX Helper
presets.prompt: glowing particle effects swirling around subject, soft volumetric haze, magical energy trails, depth of field
